description_for_human: Agent-native product marketplace. Query products by natural-language goal, top up credits, onboard Shopify merchants.
description_for_model: TexMKT is an open product marketplace for AI agents. POST a natural-language goal to find products across Shopify merchant catalogs. Requires agent_id and prepaid credits ($0.10/query). Endpoints: match (goal search), topup (Stripe checkout for credits), onboard (merchant registration), merchants (list). Discovery manifest at /.well-known/texmkt.json.
